title: A love for the Star Wars Prequals

commenti.body:
I did the same process but rewatched originals -> sequels -> prequels with my other half, she’s never seen Star Wars. The phantom menace is honestly very much solid. The production value is really high and the soundtrack floors you. I didn’t mind Jake Lloyd either.

Attack of the clones is bad, there’s no word about it. Hayden was directed poorly and it makes the film almost awkward. The CGI is unreal though.

Revenge of the Sith was my favourite mainly for the Lego when I was a kid. It’s a depressing film though and has a lot of pacing issues. Anakins turn isn’t really in depth but Hayden is fantastic in it compared to attack of the clones.

Star Wars fans are crazy sometimes, it’s almost like a cult. There’s nothing too wrong with the prequels, id take them over the sequels ANYDAY. It’s no wonder George sold it, phantom menace was his baby and it got tarnished.

I love the phantom menace, it holds a lot of nostalgia for me.

I respect them for being the sole manifestation of a single visionary mind, rather than the focus group product of a cynical board meeting. 

But they’re still incredibly flawed, the prequels have great ideas but it’s all poorly tied together by a largely aimless narrative that doesn’t really kick into gear until the last film and some truly god awful writing especially in Attack of the Clones, I know it’s become a meme but it really is unacceptable for a major Hollywood production have writing that amateurish. 

I respect that Lucas had full creative control but he should have handed the script to Lawrence Kasdan or even gotten Timothy Zahn involved because the screenplay is what really let’s those films down the most.

I think Star Wars has been a largely disappointing franchise I genuinely consider the original trilogy to be great films. But everything else Prequels, Sequels, Spin offs and mini series alike has been hampered by poor screenplays, wonky direction and meddling studio interference it really is a shame.
